scope: Only the external seal-source.py was adjusted. Read-only ZIP/source inspection and AST parsing; no seal execution, repository/archive write, test or image request.
change: The seal checks all existing raw integrated ZIP members, retains matching members without truncation, and appends only missing members verified against the same accepted bytes.
guards: Canonical relative ZIP filenames only; reject absolute paths, traversal, backslashes, colons, NUL, directories and duplicate entries.
Draft members must match current bytes already pinned by integrated.reviewedAssetHashes; the integrated report itself must match its current accepted raw bytes.
repo/... members must match both integrated.reviewedPublicAssetHashes and actual current repository bytes.

The sole named auxiliary validate-integrated.py member must equal both current external and readable archived helper bytes; it is explicitly auxiliary provenance, not a fabricated visual-review binding.
Reject any other unchecked extra or changed accepted member; recheck final member accounting and byte equality.
oldPrepublicationReview: prepublication-registration-review.json remains unchanged and historical; it does not claim review of the new seal hash.
executionBoundary: After the frozen full verify, parent must copy this updated script into the source archive, format copied text as usual, then execute sealing. No production merge or completion claim here.
